label: PASS
reason: no contact, inside the corridor and the envelope; min margin r = 0.30 (clearance 1.03, road 0.30, friction 0.37), lane-centred at the end

scenario.description: The car ahead blows a tyre, skids along the ego's lane, then slides across into the left or the right lane; which one shows only t_reveal s after it loses control. Brake in lane, commit early to a side, or brake and escape to the side it is not sliding to once that is seen; a heavy vehicle close behind cannot follow a hard stop.

constraints.name: clearance
constraints.definition: min over ticks and actors of min(footprint distance, footprint distance predicted 0.3 s ahead at the closing velocity) - 0.5 m reserve, capped at 2 m

constraints.name: road
constraints.definition: min distance of the ego footprint inside the permitted corridor (scenario bounds)

constraints.name: friction
constraints.definition: min of 1 - commanded combined acceleration / usable friction budget

constraints.name: terminal
constraints.definition: at the horizon: lane-centred and straight (the terminal contract); not reached when the run ended early

constraints.name: no_contact
constraints.definition: no footprint overlap with any actor, and no CARLA collision event; impact_speed = closing speed at the contact

constraints.name: goal
constraints.required: inside the corridor, lane-centred at the horizon
constraints.definition: the scenario's own end condition (spec.goal), e.g. merged into the target lane

constraints.name: envelope
constraints.definition: measured acceleration inside the vehicle's 1 g contract

pass_rule: PASS = every constraint passed (margins >= 0.05); margin r = min of clearance, road, friction and terminal

policy_source.optimizer: vsearch: the family's settings, then iCEM (search/cem.py) on the worst-case cost over case.perturbed

observation.source: line of sight (sight.py): an actor is delivered while visible from the driver's eye (held 0.3 s after it disappears); background traffic outside the corridor is never delivered
